create_quantized_tensor_from_dequantized: create a QuantizedTensor from a dequantized tensor using init_from_dequantized_tensor with a target dtype and BlockInfo
dequantize_quantized_tensor: dequantize a QuantizedTensor to a specified float dtype and return the resulting tensor
build_quantized_tensor_list: build a QuantizedTensorList from a sequence of tuples containing tensors and optional min max values
compress_quantized_tensor_list: compress a QuantizedTensorList using a boolean selector tuple to filter out selected tensors
use_dequantize_context_manager: use DequantizeQuantizedTensorListContext to auto dequantize on enter and quantize on exit within a with block
